from machine import I2C, Pin
import framebuf
import time
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({D}), scl=Pin({C}))
A = 0x70
time.sleep(1)
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x21')
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x81')
i2c.writeto(A, b'\xEF')
buf = bytearray(8)
fb = framebuf.FrameBuffer(buf, 8, 8, framebuf.MONO_HLSB)
fb.text('K', 0, 0, 1)
ram = bytearray(16)
for y in range(8):
    b = 0
    for x in range(8):
        if fb.pixel(x, y):
            b |= 1 << ((x + 7) % 8)  # Adafruit 8x8 backpack column wiring
    ram[2 * y] = b
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x00' + ram)
while True:
    time.sleep(1)
